8012.gloss: Half have no internal check on whether assessments work
8012.verbatim: 50.8% of HR and TA practitioners have no internal check on assessment validity, combining "no one formally validates — we go on gut feel" (44.5%) with "TA leadership relies on vendor claims" (6.3%) (n=128). [Q9]
8012.source_note: SHRM Labs x Testlify: Skills Assessments — Topline Report
